convert_model_to_MOLE_model: convert a PyTorch model to a MOLE model by replacing linear layers with MOLE expert layers
replace_linear_with_MOLE: replace a linear module with a MOLE or MOLEDGL expert layer using cached or fresh instances
recursive_replace_so2_linear: recursively replace all fc_m0 and so2_m_conv fc linear layers within SO2_Convolution modules with MOLE layers
recursive_replace_all_linear: recursively replace all torch.nn.Linear layers in a model tree with MOLE expert layers
model_search_and_replace: search and replace modules in specific model blocks using a provided search function and replacement factory
